items:
15 Mathis Cove by Royal Destinations

Location: Inlet Beach
Address: 15 Mathis Cove, Inlet Beach, FL 32461

Details:
Conveniently located in Inlet Beach, just 1.5 blocks from the shore, 15 Mathis Cove is a pet-friendly, European-style villa perfect for families, groups, or friends' getaways. This beautiful home offers Gulf views, quick beach access, a community pool, and stunning interiors. With 4 bedrooms, including 2 king suites, a queen bedroom, and a bunk room, it accommodates various groups comfortably. The first floor houses the queen bedroom and bunk room, while a spiral staircase leads to the main floor featuring a modern kitchen with Viking appliances, quartz countertops, and dining for up to 8 guests. The balcony includes a gas grill and additional seating. The third floor boasts two luxurious king suites, each with flat-screen TVs, Gulf-view balconies, and elegant bathrooms featuring walk-in showers, soaking tubs, and double vanities. Relax on the spacious balcony or enjoy the private community pool shared by just eight homes in The Heron community.

If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental.

Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- 15 Mathis Cove is ideally located on the desirable east end of 30A, just 1.5 blocks from a quiet, no-parking beach access near Phillips Inlet. New hardwood flooring on the 2nd and 3rd levels. Built with insulated concrete forms for superior soundproofing, it occupies the best lot in the community—set back from the road and close to the water. Thoughtfully designed for privacy, the home features spacious hallways, generous closets, and an updated bunkroom with privacy curtains. A full floor is dedicated to living and entertaining, highlighted by a striking 40-foot-high entryway.

Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Sundog Books and Emerald Coast Mirror Maze are also worth visiting. Swimming offers a great chance to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling and hiking/biking trails nearby.
